title: Immunofluorescence Assay to Detect Respiratory Syncytial Virus
author: Maria Lucia Silva
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.w8ufhww

steps.title: Fix cells with cold acetone
steps.instruction: Immerse the cells in pure cold acetone for 5 min.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash the sample three times with PBS, 3 min each at room temperature.

steps.title: Permeabilize cells
steps.instruction: Incubate cells in 0.1 % Triton‑X100 for 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash after permeabilization
steps.instruction: Wash the sample three times with PBS, 3 min each at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate primary antibody
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1:100 dilution of anti‑RSV blend monoclonal antibody (MAB858‑4; Millipore, MA, USA) in PBS containing 1 % BSA and 0.2 % Tween 20. Add to cells and incubate in a humidified chamber for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash after primary
steps.instruction: Wash the sample three times with PBS, 5 min each at room temperature.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample for 15 min at room temperature in block solution consisting of 10 % specific serum diluted in 1X PBS.

steps.title: Wash after blocking
steps.instruction: Wash the sample three times with PBS, 3 min each at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Dilute Donkey anti‑mouse IgG (H+L) Alexa Fluor® 488 (Life Technologies, Thermo Scientific, Carlsbad, CA, USA) 1:200 in PBS with 1 % BSA. Add to cells and incubate in a humidified chamber for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash after secondary
steps.instruction: Wash the sample three times with PBS, 5 min each at room temperature.

steps.title: Stain nuclei with DAPI
steps.instruction: Prepare 5 µg ml⁻¹ DAPI solution in PBS. Incubate cells for 5 min at room temperature in a humidified chamber.

steps.title: Final PBS washes
steps.instruction: Wash the sample two times with PBS, 5 min each at room temperature.

steps.title: Mount coverslip
steps.instruction: Place a drop of mounting medium (90 % glycerol diluted in PBS) on the slide and mount the coverslip.

steps.title: Seal coverslip
steps.instruction: Seal the coverslip edges with nail polish to prevent drying and movement.

steps.title: Store slides
steps.instruction: Store the prepared slides in the dark at –20 °C or +4 °C.
